limits.v_max.note: the manufacturer recommends staying within -0.6..0.6 m/s; this is not the top speed

limits.w_max.method: The manufacturer does not publish the maximum angular velocity; a conservative 1.0 rad/s is used, in line with TurtleBot3 Waffle Pi (1.82) and TurtleBot 4 (1.90). The kinematic bound 2*v_max/track width is not used because it far exceeds the practical safe limit.

lidar.method: JetAuto comes with a SLAMTEC A1 or an EAI G4 option; the A1M8 is used (0.15-12 m per the SLAMTEC datasheet).
